beats.say: Doctor Who regenerates to survive a fatal injury or impending death.
The process completely changes their appearance and personality while keeping their memories.
Time Lords normally have twelve regenerations, making for thirteen lives in total.
That is like a phone lasting through thirteen battery replacements before it finally stops working.
A new twist called bi-generation even allows the Doctor to split into two distinct bodies.
This biology means the hero can survive almost anything the universe throws at them.

facts: The Doctor is able to undergo regeneration usually due to impending death or severe injury.
Regeneration completely changes the Doctor's appearance and personality while maintaining their memories.
Time Lords are normally capable of regenerating twelve times, making for a total of thirteen lives.
Bi-generation was introduced in the 2023 episode The Giggle where the Time Lord splits into two distinct bodies.
